title: Buttery Gulab Jamun Snack
description: A sweet and indulgent Indian-inspired snack made with gulab jamun and lightly buttery goodness.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Open the package of gulab jamun and gently place them in the hot oil.
Fry the gulab jamun until they turn golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried gulab jamun from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, powdered sugar, and cardamom powder (if using).
Drizzle the butter mixture over the fried gulab jamun.
Serve the buttery gulab jamun hot and enjoy!
Note: If you prefer a crisper coating, you can chill the fried gulab jamun in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.
